name: Commissioner Capone
caption: The federation's own on-screen commissioner, who signed its first wave of talent and introduced its debut roster in its own founding promo pack.

tenures.source: The federation's own first flash pack, "ESWA Word On The Mat!" (17 November 1997).

name: Eddie Extreme
caption: A wrestler flown from Charlotte to New York for the federation's own first-ever card, introduced touring its offices and the high school gym that would host it.

tenures.source: The federation's own first flash pack, "ESWA Word On The Mat!" (17 November 1997).

name: Doomsday
caption: A masked, apocalyptic-themed wrestler who promised to finish every opponent with the Doomsday Device on his way to the federation's own Heavyweight Championship.

tenures.source: The federation's own first flash pack, "ESWA Word On The Mat!" (17 November 1997).

identity.note: Shares only a common ring name with several unrelated wrestlers and one unrelated tag team billed as "Doomsday" elsewhere in the held record; no operator, roster, or date overlap links them.

name: The Dean
caption: A gym-dwelling brawler who vowed to give every rival "the Failing Grade" on his own way to the federation's own Heavyweight Championship.

tenures.source: The federation's own first flash pack, "ESWA Word On The Mat!" (17 November 1997).

identity.note: Shares only a common ring name with an unrelated wrestler billed as "The Dean" elsewhere in the held record; no operator, roster, or date overlap links them.

name: Shawn Smash
caption: A wrestler with a single prior professional match, introduced looking to join or form a stable in the federation's own debut roster.

tenures.source: The federation's own first flash pack, "ESWA Word On The Mat!" (17 November 1997).

name: Pierre
caption: One half of the tag team the European Union, introduced promising to win the federation's own tag team title.

tenures.source: The federation's own first flash pack, "ESWA Word On The Mat!" (17 November 1997).

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (pierre-uwow); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: Demitri
caption: One half of the tag team the European Union, introduced alongside Pierre promising to win the federation's own tag team title.

tenures.source: The federation's own first flash pack, "ESWA Word On The Mat!" (17 November 1997).

identity.note: Shares only a similar ring name with an unrelated wrestler billed as "Demetrius" elsewhere in the held record; no operator, roster, or date overlap links them.

name: the Dynamite Kid
caption: A self-described former Junior LightHeavyweight European and NWD Lightweight Champion, introduced promising to prove Great Britain has great stars.

tenures.source: The federation's own first flash pack, "ESWA Word On The Mat!" (17 November 1997).

identity.note: Shares only a common ring name (after the real-life wrestler of the same name) with several unrelated characters billed as "Dynamite Kid" elsewhere in the held record; no operator, roster, or date overlap links them.

name: El Fuego
caption: A masked luchador claiming a Mexican pedigree (billed former MCF World and Lightweight Champion), introduced as Commissioner Capone's own signing to capitalize on a lucha libre boom.

tenures.source: The federation's own first flash pack, "ESWA Word On The Mat!" (17 November 1997).

name: Chris K
caption: A 23-year-old rookie wrestler introduced as an ordinary fan-turned-competitor, training in a gym ahead of the federation's own debut card.

tenures.source: The federation's own first flash pack, "ESWA Word On The Mat!" (17 November 1997).
